manual.label: 20 bits share the word with TC, S and TTL; scapy's 20-bit BitField clamps logical bits at and above bit 20, so the per-bit probe cannot isolate them, and the mask/shift view is hand-declared per RFC 3032 section 2.1 and crosscheck-verified
manual.traffic_class: 3 bits share byte 2 with the label tail and the S bit; scapy's 3-bit BitField clamps the logical bits, so the per-bit probe cannot isolate them, and the mask/shift view is hand-declared per RFC 3032 section 2.1 and crosscheck-verified
manual.bottom_of_stack: 1 bit shares byte 2 with the label tail and TC; the single-bit probe cannot produce a byte-contrast pair, so the mask/shift view is hand-declared per RFC 3032 section 2.1 and crosscheck-verified
